fix(links): a cycle link names its step, so clicks that land before the bar redraws add up (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5f9) (#957)

* fix(links): a cycle link names its step, so clicks that land before the bar redraws add up (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5f9)

A set or persist cycle and a {{ menu }} trigger now carry the action and the
step, never the member they land on, so the link is the same on every draw and
N clicks land N steps. The click reads where the key stands when it arrives.

- a persist ring starts from what the bar wears while the session holds a pick
  of the key, and ring-config releases that pick so it stops shadowing the file
- a click's adjacent state writes (a trigger's step and its page reset) are one
  write: every pair validates before any lands
- a menu step reads in words by the member it opens, so two menus on one
  shared key never read alike

* fix(links): one fold joins a click's state writes, and review pass 1's smaller findings (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5f9)

A click's adjacent set-state and ring-state effects are joined once, at admission, into one state-writes step; set-state leaves the text batching beside reset-config. The step carries no verb of its own, and its write type no longer shares a name with the disclosure's. The menu trigger shares one render binding; the picker's close names the holding-current sentinel; the menu-action inverse sits beside its producer with a round-trip test; test helpers read a stepped ring through one lookup.

* fix(links): a structural insert holds no ring, the step-config log keeps its space, and a run of state writes reports under each write's own verb (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5f9)

* docs(links): the state-writes refusal comment says whose message it is (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5f9)

test(controls): each control is declared once with its mark and arrows, the ring is refused when the picker pages, and every ring comment says the link carries its step and never its landing (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7o3)

Review pass 2 on #958.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(controls): each control over a per-draw rule is read on its own row, and every ◀ ▶ ? steps from the option the draw wore; a ring step near the safe range lands exactly (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7o3)

Review pass 1 on #958. The test now reads each control's row alone, takes
the ring from the picker, clicks ◀ and ▶ of the carousel and the swatches
row in every domain after a draw at the other answer, and checks ? lands
off the worn option. ringAround reduces the offset before adding the
centre, so its sum never rounds. The ring headers say the link carries the
worn name while a rule decides the key.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(controls): a carousel, picker, swatches row and swatch over a key a per-draw rule chooses mark and step from what the bar wears (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7o3)

A theme, style or effect rule that reads `now` is evaluated in each draw.
Every control that centres on the key already reads the name that draw's
rule settled on; no test drew one under such a rule, only under a rule
settled once and kept. One rig is drawn at alternating instants, so a
reader that kept the first draw's answer or fell to the floor fails it.
